breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the thin-walled tube approximation, stating 'Use standard thin-walled tube torsion formulas' in the Calculation Method and listing 'Thin-walled closed tube model' and 'Mean-area shear-flow relation will be applied' in the Assumptions. The ground truth removes this thin-walled model entirely and relies solely on the exact thick-walled torsion relation using J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32. The Agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
